195594936.title: File:Girl cradling a doll - Baby's Story Book (1879).jpg

ObjectName.value: Girl cradling a doll - Baby's Story Book (1879)

Categories.value: Unidentified artists|PD US expired|Template Unknown (author)|1879 book illustrations|Girls with dolls in art|Cradles in art

ImageDescription.value:
An illustration of a girl sitting on a chair, looking down lovingly at the doll she cradles in one arm. She sits beside an empty cradle. Artist unknown.

The image accompanied a short rhyme titled, The Lit-tle Mo-ther:

A hap-pi-er cou-ple I nev-er did see
Than lit-tle Pau-line and her dear Ro-sa-lie.
A good lit-tle doll and a good lit-tle child,
To judge from their fa-ces, so cheer-ful and mild.

Credit.value: Baby's Story Book: with pictures and silhouettes for our little ones; edited by Laura E. Richards; published by Estes & Lauriat, Boston, 1879
